text:
incident-bot: PAGE FIRED -> PagerDuty: network-oncall. Trigger: ALB target resets + spike in DNS NXDOMAIN rates for edge cluster (us-west-2). Auto-severity: P2.
pagerduty: INC-8392 created and routed to network-oncall. Escalation policy: 5m -> 15m.
aj_khan: acked :hand: I'm on it, pulling metrics now. Anyone saw recent deploys to edge-lb?
lee_ops: I'm seeing an uptick in TLS handshake failures and backend resets starting ~00:10 UTC. Frontend TLS errors (SNI mismatch) are ↑, but more telling are repeated 502/connection-reset from targets. quick metric: 5xx rate from edge-proxy = 3.4% (baseline 0.03%).
maria.dev: who touched traffic routing or DNS? I didn't deploy anything.
lee_ops: no infra deploys in last 2 hours. DNS change log shows a flurry of requests for nonexistent subdomains (spike in NXDOMAIN responses). Might be a client misconfig / aggressive retrying causing target churn?
noah_sre: can you paste a snippet of the ALB target logs and the TLS errors?
lee_ops: logs: 
```
[2026-03-14T00:10:12Z] target/10.0.45.12: health check failed, connection reset by peer
[2026-03-14T00:10:12Z] TLSHandshakeError: alert handshake failure (sni: "api.example-customer.net")
[2026-03-14T00:10:13Z] target/10.0.45.13: deregistering - unhealthy
[2026-03-14T00:10:14Z] client-ip=34.82.9.1 path=/v1/generate status=502
```
eli_support: support seeing a spike in tickets: customers complaining about intermittent 502 and timeouts. Affected tenants: 8 (mid-market), a few PLG dev keys see token generation failures.
aj_khan: quick triage plan: 1) stop aggressive DNS TTL polling -> check edge DNS resolver metrics 2) scale target group to reduce per-target load 3) rollback any recent weight/route changes 4) if needed, failover traffic regionally.
noah_sre: agreed. I'm going to temporarily increase target-group capacity and raise ALB health check healthy threshold to avoid flapping. Executing: 
```
# add two warm standby instances into tg
aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name edge-tg-asg-usw2 --desired-capacity 6
# relax health checks
aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:... --attributes Key=slow_start.duration_seconds,Value=30 Key=deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds,Value=60
```
lee_ops: also rolling back a recent weighted-route change from traffic-weights service (we pushed 80/20 split to a new pool at 00:05). Rolling back to 95/5 now. Command: `trafficctl set-weights --service edge-api --weights 95,5`
infra-bot: route weights updated successfully.
aj_khan: I'm going to throttle resolver queries at the edge layer to reduce stray NXDOMAIN amplification (short term). Patch config: `resolver.cache_ttl = 30s` applied.
maria.dev: tentative customer impact: some long-tail keys experienced failed completions for ~12 minutes during peak. We should surface to sales/customer success.
eli_support: posting a summary to #support: "Intermittent 502s for ~12m due to ALB target flapping compounded by DNS query spike; mitigation: scaled targets and rolled back routing weights; monitoring."
noah_sre: health metrics are improving. 5xx down to 0.6% and TLS handshake errors trending down. Keeping on-call monitoring.
aj_khan: handing off to noah_sre for longer remediation and postmortem. I'm stepping off after monitoring window.
noah_sre: taking on-call. next steps: audit DNS TTLs for customers, add rate-limit for NXDOMAIN storming, add runbook entry for target flapping + weight rollback. Assigning follow-up to maria.dev for postmortem and remediation timeline.
incident-bot: STATUS CHANGE -> mitigated (partial) by actions taken. PagerDuty: auto-close escalation after 30m if no further pages.
maria.dev: noted, will draft postmortem and propose runbook updates. ETA for draft: EOD.
eli_support: created support incident bundle, notifying affected customers with interim workaround.
noah_sre: leaving final note: cause hypothesis = combination of client-side DNS misconfiguration triggering mass NXDOMAIN retries + a recent weight redistribution that reduced headroom on a subset of targets, resulting in aggressive health check churn and TLS handshake issues.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED -> INC-8392 marked resolved at 2345678980. Postmortem assigned. :white_check_mark:
